confidence_basis: Main PDF, OpenDataLoader output, fallback text extraction, rendered methods pages, publisher HTML, and the downloaded supplement were checked. Segment 1-4 values are mostly reported, with remaining uncertainty around exact auditory file duration, precise SOA milliseconds, trial randomization/blocking, response timeout, and exact baseline/catch decomposition.

profile_recreation_assessment.reason: Experiment 1 can be recreated as a two-speaker or digital two-source trunk-anchored looming/receding pink-noise task with reported D1-D6 distances, 22 cm/s speed, dB envelopes, tactile apparatus, baseline strategy, ITI jitter, and total/repetition formula. Exact envelope files and the full count split for baseline/catch trials would need approximation.

source_checks.scope: PDF pages 2-3 for Experiment 1 setup/results and pages 11-13 for Methods, Stimuli and Apparatus, Procedure, Design, and trial counts.
Used as the primary extracted text map, then checked against rendered PDF pages and fallback extraction.
Checked the 2-speaker setup, loudspeaker model, pink-noise provenance, dB envelopes, and validation section.
Fallback supplement text was searched for speaker, pink noise, SoundForge, SPL, looming, receding, and validation terms.
Targeted searches for stimulus, apparatus, distance, speed, SOA, baseline, catch, trial count, repetition, ITI, and response parameters.
Visual methods-page check; temporary rendered images were not committed.
Official article page checked for Experiment 1, Methods, Figure 1, and supplementary-information routes.

review_attempts.result: Mapped candidate Segment 1-4 values across 20 of 25 fields.
pdfplumber and pdftotext confirmed tactile apparatus, acoustic setup, D1-D6 distances, baseline/catch logic, total trials, repetitions, and ITI jitter.
Rendered methods pages were checked visually to verify page flow around apparatus, procedure, design, and trial-count paragraphs.
Supplement supplied loudspeaker model, 1 m separation, near/far placement, pink-noise samples, SoundForge provenance, and 55-70 dB exponential envelopes.
Separated Exp. 1 from the other six experiments and kept only the 2-speaker, trunk, D1-D6, 22 cm/s looming/receding profile.

review_attempts.strategy: Sequence, baseline, catch, and repetition pass
review_attempts.result: Identified three trial families, two baseline timings, sound-only catches, x16 repetition formula, 240 total trials, and the unresolved baseline/catch exact split.
Official Nature page and local supplement were checked; no additional downloadable methods tables or stimulus files were found.

stimulus_type.evidence_note: Supplement reports pink-noise samples used for the auditory stimuli.

source_provenance.value: SoundForge 4.5 shaped pink-noise samples; exact source WAV/noise seed is not reported.
source_provenance.evidence_note: Software provenance is reported in the supplement, but not the original sound asset.

trajectory_count.value: Two auditory motion directions in Experiment 1: looming and receding.
trajectory_count.page_or_section: PDF pp.2, 11-12, Experiment 1 and Acoustic Stimuli
trajectory_count.evidence_note: Experiment 1 crossed Sound Direction with six distances.

trajectory_path.value: Near speaker about 5 cm from the participant and far speaker about 1 m away; looming far-to-near, receding near-to-far, anchored to trunk/chest.
trajectory_path.evidence_note: Main paper gives D1-D6 distances; supplement gives physical near/far speaker placement.

stimulus_duration.value: Full auditory path duration is not directly stated; 100 cm path at 22 cm/s implies about 4.55 s for the far-near motion.
stimulus_duration.evidence_note: Derived from reported path length and velocity; exact file length is not independently reported.

stimulus_speed.value: Experiment 1 auditory motion traveled at 22 cm/s over a 100 cm near-far speaker distance.
stimulus_speed.evidence_note: The 2-speaker setup used 22 cm/s in Experiment 1, 4, and 5.

auditory_conditions.value: Looming and receding sounds were used while tactile targets were delivered to the trunk/chest.
auditory_conditions.page_or_section: PDF pp.2, 12, Experiment 1 and Acoustic Stimuli
auditory_conditions.evidence_note: Experiment 1 uses both sound directions; looming drives the reported PPS effect.

gain_envelope.value: Looming intensity rose exponentially from 55 to 70 dB SPL; receding decreased from 70 to 55 dB SPL, with near/far speaker intensities mirrored.
gain_envelope.evidence_note: Supplement gives dB endpoints and qualitative exponential mirror pattern.

renderer_or_apparatus.value: Two M-Audio Studiophile AV 360 loudspeakers facing each other, one near and one far, coactivated with differential intensity.
renderer_or_apparatus.evidence_note: Supplement reports speaker make/model and geometry; room transfer is not reported.

trial_rows_families.value: Three trial families: bimodal audio-tactile target trials, unimodal tactile baseline trials, and unimodal auditory catch trials.
trial_rows_families.evidence_note: The design section explicitly lists the three trial types.

condition_intermixing.value: Experiment 1 combines multisensory D1-D6 trials, D1/D6 baselines, and catch trials within the same task; exact trial-order algorithm is not stated.
condition_intermixing.evidence_note: Formula reports one combined experiment rather than separate task phases.

blocked_or_random_order.page_or_section: PDF pp.11-13, Procedure/Design; official Nature HTML checked 2026-06-16
blocked_or_random_order.evidence_note: No explicit block count, block structure, or trial randomization algorithm was found for Experiment 1.

iti_jitter_policy.value: Inter-trial intervals were randomly shuffled between 500 and 700 ms.
iti_jitter_policy.evidence_note: The ITI range is reported after the per-experiment trial-count formulas.

response_window.page_or_section: PDF pp.11-13, Procedure/Design; official Nature HTML checked 2026-06-16
response_window.evidence_note: Button-press response and catch withholding are reported, but no explicit response timeout/window was found.

task_sequence_rules.value: Participants responded rapidly to tactile vibration, ignored sounds, withheld responses on sound-only catches, and baseline trials omitted sound.
task_sequence_rules.page_or_section: PDF pp.11-12, General Procedure and Design
task_sequence_rules.evidence_note: The procedure states the response rule and no-go catch rule.

tactile_stimulus.value: Single Precision MicroDrives 312-101 shaftless vibration motor on upper chest/sternum; 150 Hz motor; tactile stimulation lasted 100 ms.
tactile_stimulus.evidence_note: The Methods list motor model, body site, and stimulation duration for Experiment 1.

soa_table.value: Six distance-at-touch levels D1-D6: 5, 24, 43, 62, 81, and 100 cm; timing offsets are dictated by 22 cm/s and reverse for looming.
soa_table.evidence_note: Distances are tabulated in prose; exact SOA milliseconds are not separately tabulated.

baseline_strategy.value: Unimodal tactile-only baseline trials without auditory stimulation; fastest baseline RT was subtracted from multisensory RTs.
baseline_strategy.evidence_note: The paper describes baseline correction using the fastest unimodal tactile condition.

baseline_timing.value: Baseline trials used two temporal delays corresponding to the nearest and farthest sampled distances, D1 and D6.
baseline_timing.evidence_note: The exact millisecond timings are not tabulated but are tied to the D1/D6-equivalent timings.

catch_trial_type.value: Unimodal auditory catch trials: sound presented without tactile stimulation; participants withheld response.
catch_trial_type.evidence_note: Catch trials were used to prevent automatic responding and check attention.

repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.value: Experiment 1 formula reports [multisensory D1-D6 + baselines D1/D6 + catch trials] x 2 directions x 16 repetitions.
repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.evidence_note: The repetition factor is explicit, though catch/baseline decomposition is not.

baseline_count.value: General design says about 20% unimodal tactile baselines; with 240 Exp.1 trials this is about 48, but exact D1/D6-by-direction split is not stated.
baseline_count.evidence_note: Derived from the reported percentage and total; formula confirms two baseline timings.

catch_count.value: General design says about 10% auditory catch trials; with 240 Exp.1 trials this is about 24, but exact catch count per sound direction is not stated.
catch_count.evidence_note: Derived from the reported percentage and total; paper does not give an exact Exp.1 catch count.

block_count.page_or_section: PDF pp.11-13, Methods; official Nature HTML checked 2026-06-16
block_count.evidence_note: The paper says experiments never exceeded 60 minutes, but no Experiment 1 block count was found.

total_trial_count.evidence_note: The total is explicitly reported in the design paragraph.

critical_caveats: Exact original pink-noise WAV/noise seed is not reported.
Exact SoundForge gain/envelope file is not provided beyond exponential direction and dB endpoints.
Auditory file duration is derived from path length and speed; no standalone file duration is reported.
Exact SOA milliseconds for D1-D6 and D1/D6 baselines are not tabulated.
Exact trial-order randomization, block count, and response timeout/window are not reported.
Exact Experiment 1 baseline and catch counts are only derivable approximately from percentages and total trials.
next_manual_action: This paper is strong enough for a runnable trunk two-speaker/digital two-source profile, with exact gain files, exact SOA table, and exact baseline/catch count split treated as approximations unless author materials become available.
